# `jouet claim`

- **Usage:** `jouet claim [--for <DUR>] [--note <TEXT>] [PATHS]… [SUBCOMMAND]`

Claim paths for this session, so other sessions are warned off them

A claim is advisory: it blocks nothing. It tells other agent sessions on this machine that this session works on these paths, and jouet's hooks warn a session that edits or commits a path another live session claims, naming that session and its worktree. Every worktree of a repository shares its claims. PATH is a file, a directory (covering everything under it) or a glob (`*`, `**`, `?`). A claim lasts --for (default 2h), and lapses early when its worktree is removed or its agent exits. Claiming a path again renews it. Refuses (exit 1) when another live session claims an overlapping path, naming it; exits 4 outside an agent session (set JOUET_SESSION_ID to claim from elsewhere).

## Arguments
- **`[PATHS]…`** — The files, directories or globs to claim

## Flags
- **`--for <DUR>`** — How long the claim lasts (default 2h)
- **`--note <TEXT>`** — What the session is doing there, shown to the others
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
